featured_reviews.name: Kshitija Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text: The studio has a great vibe and the overall atmosphere is really nice. However, I was quite let down by the choreographer. featured_reviews.name: Mikki Mehrotra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had joined the Zumba class with Sagar Sir in January and paid the full fees. After a few sessions, the classes suddenly stopped. When I raised the issue, Sagar himself said he would return my money — even though I didn’t ask him to. But now, he is not responding to my calls and hasn’t refunded the amount.

On top of that, the studio space was very unhygienic — hair strands were all over the floor, and when I pointed it out, he simply said “No, it’s clean, you just lie down and do exercise.” It felt careless and unprofessional.

He also doesn’t seem to remember why he had taken leave or why the classes were discontinued. Very disappointing experience — both in terms of hygiene and accountability. I wouldn’t recommend this class based on my experience

featured_reviews.name: Preethi Aravind
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kalanga Kathak
My experience has been wonderful. Didi teaches Kathak very well. Everyone who comes here is able to give a new direction to their Kathak dance. Kathak is not just a dance, but an art form. That's why this institute is called Kalanga. Coming here has given me a wonderful platform to learn Kathak. Kalanga is the largest Kathak dance institute in Powai.
A special thanks to Molly Didi, who always teaches and encourages the students in her class about Kathak dance, which gives them a special boost.

featured_reviews.name: Angara Saxena
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been learning from Moli didi for 2.5 years now. She has been a wonderful guru, guiding us through the nuances of Kathak. I was very new to Kathak when I joined, but never felt out of place here. I was able to quickly learn the steps under her guidance, and she has made it very methodical, fun and practical. Love being part of the Kalaangan family :)

featured_reviews.name: Roshni Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Authentic Kathak experience!
Moli Mam is just an amazing kathak dancer and this is what she wants to reflect in her students.
The class is fun filled and enjoyable. Mam is just a one man army but teaches with a lot of patience.
I would recommend people to join kalaangan to learn kathak in its original way. ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Pravina Awate
featured_reviews.review_text: “One of the best Kathak school in the area! The guru explains every step clearly and focuses on expressions as well as footwork. Classes are very positive.”

featured_reviews.name: Rakhi Panchal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I want to take a moment to express my heartfelt gratitude for all the experiences and invaluable knowledge I have gained at Kalaangan under our Guru Smt. Moli Didi's esteemed guidance. Her humility and down-to-earth nature are truly inspiring.

The environment cultivated at Kalaangan feels more like a family, where each student is encouraged to learn from their mistakes. I truly feel blessed to be part of this community.

Every session is not only an opportunity to master the art of Kathak but also a chance to learn valuable life lessons from Moli Didi. Her dedication to nurturing and fostering talent in all students is commendable. Thank you for your unwavering support and encouragement; it motivates us to strive for excellence in our dance journey.

featured_reviews.name: Kriti Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: Moli ma’am is very attentive towards each student. She explains students all aspects of kathak including mathematical, practical, theoretical etc. which makes it easier to understand the dance form and also connect to its cultural roots. No other teacher refines basics and pays attention to the smallest details like Moli ma’am. She is very encouraging and thorough in her teachings. I am really lucky to be one of her students. 🙏

featured_reviews.name: aradhana shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kalaangan is not only a place were  you learn dance but is also where you learn to see life in the most positive way. Moli Aunty has been my guru since I was in school. The little grace in my dance that I have is all credit to Moli Aunty.

I highly recommend Kalaangan to everyone who respects Indian classical dance and wishes to learn from the best.

featured_reviews.name: Nishi Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been learning kathak at kalaangan for more than 4 years now, I have not only learnt about dance techniques but also social skills and teamwork.
Our guru smt. Moli Siddharth not only builds confidence but also instills many values in us. I enjoy and look forward to to my classes every week!
I traveled to Athens Greece with ma'am for the first Indian world dance conference hosted by UNESCO the cultural wing of United Nations. The experience was ethereal and I look forward it more such trips with ma'am
- Nishi Pawar

featured_reviews.name: Tanvi Pednekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am a dedicated Bharatanatyam dancer and feel truly grateful to be part of this dance institution. My journey here has been one of discipline, growth, and deep connection with Indian classical art. The classes are well-structured, systematic, and rooted in tradition, while also encouraging confidence and stage presence.

Our guru/sir is extremely knowledgeable, patient, and inspiring. His teaching goes beyond just steps—he emphasizes abhinaya, rhythm, expressions, theory, and the cultural essence of Bharatanatyam. Every student is guided personally, with attention to detail and encouragement to improve continuously. The learning environment is positive, respectful, and motivating.

Through this dance class, I have grown not only as a dancer but also as an individual, gaining dedication, grace, and confidence. I highly recommend this institution to anyone who wishes to learn Bharatanatyam with sincerity, discipline, and strong guidance under an experienced teacher. 🌸

name: National dancesport academy
description:
Founded by the visionary Sneh Vadhani, the National Dancesport Academy (NDSA) is a celebration of artistry and athleticism. With over three decades of expertise spanning Latin ballroom, Bharatnatyam, and dance pedagogy, Sneh has redefined how movement and education intertwine. At NDSA, dance is not merely an expression—it is a powerful medium to nurture physical, emotional, and social well-being, inspiring individuals of all ages to lead fuller, more balanced lives.
Guided by the core values of Support for Dancers, Access to Dance for All, and Community Engagement, NDSA is committed to offering expansive public programming, building educational partnerships, and ensuring inclusive, equitable processes for all dancers and choreographers.

featured_reviews.name: Shyam Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: Sneh is an outstanding teacher. She has an excellent understanding of the level and kind of training that each student needs. With her you can be sure to learn any dance style easily and quickly. And you will thoroughly enjoy it! I highly recommend it.

featured_reviews.name: Rustom Vazifdar
featured_reviews.review_text: Being a senior citizen, I use dancing as a means of exercising, and it has helped me immensely, both physically and mentally. Over time I have been under the tutelage of several dance instructors, but it wasn’t until I began learning with Sneh, founder of Dancesport Academy, that my social dancing skills became noticeable and I started receiving compliments from my peers. Being so highly trained herself and having an academic background in the science of the human body, she has managed to make a person like me, who is not as flexible or agile as younger dancers, not only healthier through disciplined dancing, but more importantly look forward to the joy of social dancing, whereby my circle of friends has grown exponentially. Trust me, if you are a senior, who is shy to go on the dance floor, as I was,  then Sneh is the best person who will change your life around. My only regret is that I was not introduced to Dancesport Academy and in particular, Sneh, much earlier in life, but, as they say, better late than never.

featured_reviews.name: Plabita Kalita
featured_reviews.review_text:
My daughter has been attending the academy for the last 3 years and she loves it. She trained for Latin under Sneh and Avi and I must say both of her them have been extremely professional and fun…not to mention really talented in their own right. The individual attention and commitment towards the development of each kids skills is really commendable.
I really appreciate how dedicated Sneh and her team is in giving kids a solid dance foundation, building confidence, and providing them with a lifelong love of dance.

featured_reviews.name: Ishu Singhania
featured_reviews.review_text: This is one of its kind institute that not only focus on the learning dance form but also focus on building the overall personality for all age groups. It helps in building key attributes such as body strength, discipline, health, teamwork along with the dance. Personalized attention by Ms. Sneh is exceptionally thought through and helps the students to learn the dance form in a quick and efficient way.

I'm loving my one on one sessions and I highly recommend this to anyone who wants to learn how to dance, whether that's for fun or wanting to become a professional dancer, Sneh can get you there!

name: Dancers' Nest by Priyanka Roy
description:
At Dancers' Nest, we provide a welcoming space for dance lovers to learn, grow, and express themselves through movement. Founded by Priyanka Roy, a specialist in Belly Dance with diverse dance training, we focus on building confidence, skill, and joy in every student.

What We Offer:
✔️ Belly Dance & Belly Fusion classes
✔️ Performance training
✔️ Bolly Grace (Bollywood-inspired dance)
✔️ Freestyle dance for kids
✔️ Private lessons & workshops

We also host live shows, events, and customized one-on-one training. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced dancer, join us to explore the art of dance in a fun and supportive environment!

featured_reviews.name: Aniket Charan
featured_reviews.review_text:
We reached out to Priyanka ma’am to help us choreograph and prepare for our sangeet performance, and that too on fairly short notice. Despite the time constraint, she was incredibly accommodating, patient, and thoughtful throughout the entire process. From our very first session, she took the time to understand our comfort level, strengths, and limitations, and thoughtfully designed a routine that suited our skill level perfectly.

What truly stood out was her positive energy and encouraging approach. She broke down each step clearly, ensured we felt comfortable, and created a relaxed and enjoyable learning environment. Even when we struggled with certain moves, she remained supportive and motivated us without making us feel pressured.

Thanks to her guidance, we not only learned a well-choreographed routine but also genuinely enjoyed the preparation process. By the time of the performance, we felt confident and well-prepared.

We are truly grateful for her dedication and professionalism, and would highly recommend her to anyone looking for a talented and supportive dance instructor!

featured_reviews.name: Rakshak siya Jivan
featured_reviews.review_text: Being part of Dancers' Nest has been one of the most enriching journeys for me. Priyanka’s unique blend of belly dance and fusion creates a style that’s expressive, rooted, and vibrant. Each session is beautifully structured, balancing technique with emotional release. The space is non-judgmental and welcoming—you don’t have to look a certain way or dance a certain way to feel included. Priyanka’s belief in every student shines through her teaching.

featured_reviews.name: Khwahish Kapoor
featured_reviews.review_text: Priyanka is an exceptional teacher. Her belly dance sessions are not only technically rich but also deeply empowering. You walk out feeling stronger, inside and out.

featured_reviews.name: Pari Chauhan
featured_reviews.review_text: Joining Dancers' Nest has given me so much more than just dance lessons. The chance to perform in front of a live audience was a dream come true. Priyanka prepares you patiently, pushing your limits while never letting you feel overwhelmed. Whether you're dancing in class or under the stage lights, her belief in you stays constant. The showcase was beautifully organized, and seeing the whole community come alive on stage was unforgettable.

featured_reviews.name: Aishwarya 5D7
featured_reviews.review_text: Every class feels like a celebration of womanhood, expression, and strength. Priyanka teaches with grace and clarity, making the experience both grounding and liberating.

featured_reviews.name: Sirisha Rapolu
featured_reviews.review_text: Priyanka’s teaching isn’t just about steps—it’s about connecting with yourself. Her belly dance classes helped me feel confident and radiant again.

featured_reviews.name: Tanuku Hemasri
featured_reviews.review_text: I love how Priyanka combines different dance styles into something so unique and expressive. Her classes are therapy in motion!

featured_reviews.name: Ritul Sarthi
featured_reviews.review_text: I joined Dancers' Nest as a beginner and found a supportive space to learn, express, and connect. The fusion styles taught here are elegant and powerful.
